record.measurement_method: classical MD simulation with Nernst-Einstein relation and Haven ratio
record.evidence_quote: We find σ = 0.58 Scm−1, which is one
record.notes: Conductivity is derived from the simulated tracer diffusion coefficient via the Nernst-Einstein equation with a Haven ratio H = 0.4 taken from literature (Ref. 63); the simulation was run at 500 K (canonical ensemble, polarizable force field). Value is computed in this paper, not a literature value. No sintering or synthesis since it is a simulation.
